note: Clips are generated once into studio/library/sfx/<name>-<hash>.mp3 (same naming as the skill's sfx.py, so later episodes reuse them). 'after' is the voice line (audio/voice/NNN) the sound plays after or under (0 = before the first line); the mix places it on the picture later.

clock_flip: a digital alarm clock flipping to midnight, a tiny electronic click and a soft beep, short
fingertip_glow: a soft warm magical glow humming to life around fingertips, gentle rising shimmer, short
gold_chime: a soft magical chime as a small object turns into solid gold, warm bell shimmer with a faint metallic ring, short
gold_chime_deep: a deep slow magical chime as gold spreads over a hand, low resonant bell with a heavy metallic shimmer, warm and ominous
door_creak: a bedroom door slowly creaking open at night, old wooden hinge
gold_thud: a very heavy solid gold pillow thudding on a mattress, dull heavy metallic thump, short
gold_clank: a heavy solid gold glove dropping onto a wooden floor, dull metallic clank, short
coffee_stir: a metal spoon stirring coffee in a ceramic mug, gentle clinking
bike_crash: a soft gold bicycle frame bending under a kid with a metal creak, then a cartoon crash onto pavement
kid_giggle: a little girl giggling happily, short
car_crunch: a car turning into solid gold and sinking into mud, deep metallic crunch and a heavy squelch
news_sting: a short TV news intro sting, urgent synth hit and drums, no voices
vault_door: a massive steel bank vault door slowly closing, heavy mechanical clunk and lock
price_drop: a cartoon descending slide whistle, short
car_arrive: a car pulling up slowly on a quiet street at night, engine idling then switching off
door_knock: three firm polite knocks on a wooden front door
cars_pass: cars driving slowly past a house at night, tyres on asphalt, engines fading away
slowmo_whoosh: a deep slow-motion whoosh, time slowing down, low warped rumble
night_ambience: quiet suburban night outside a house, soft crickets, faint distant traffic, no voices
